messages.author: 1f723d378f24adbb
messages.subject: extracting "column" from a vector of simplexes
parts:
Suppose I want to extract the ith element from each simplex in a vector
of simplexes. col will not work since it is not a matrix technically.

Two questions:

1. is the best/most efficient way still a loop, eg

--8<---------------cut here---------------start------------->8---
parameters {
simplex[3] zab_W[N_W]; // will be transformed
}
transformed parameters {
vector[N_W] a_W;
vector[N_W] b_W;
for (i in 1:N_W) {
a_W[i] <- zab_W[i,1] + (1-zab_W[i,1]) * a_min[i];
b_W[i] <- (1-a_min[i]) * zab_W[i,2];
}
}
--8<---------------cut here---------------end--------------->8---

2. would it make sense to extend col to vector of vectors, and
vector-like objects?

Best,

Tamas

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] extracting "column" from a vector of simplexes
parts:
> On Sep 4, 2015, at 12:00 PM, Tamas Papp <tkp...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Suppose I want to extract the ith element from each simplex in a vector
> of simplexes.
That's going to be an array of simplexes.
> col will not work since it is not a matrix technically.

> Two questions:
>
> 1. is the best/most efficient way still a loop, eg

Yes, but it can help to do the extraction into a vector
first if you can minimize operations. Unless you are having
speed issues, I wouldn't worry about it.

>
> --8<---------------cut here---------------start------------->8---
> parameters {
> simplex[3] zab_W[N_W]; // will be transformed
> }
> transformed parameters {
> vector[N_W] a_W;
> vector[N_W] b_W;
> for (i in 1:N_W) {
> a_W[i] <- zab_W[i,1] + (1-zab_W[i,1]) * a_min[i];
> b_W[i] <- (1-a_min[i]) * zab_W[i,2];
> }
> }
> --8<---------------cut here---------------end--------------->8---
>
> 2. would it make sense to extend col to vector of vectors, and
> vector-like objects?

Yes. We're going to include syntax soon that'll let you
do zab_W[,i]. But that'll still be an array, not a vector.

- Bob
